newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan PM tells MOF to strengthen bank penalty-MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan PM tells MOF to strengthen bank penalty-MOF.

text.p: Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto has instructed the finance and justice ministers to strengthen penalties in Japan's banking law, Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuku told a news conference on Friday.
Mitsuzuka said he and Justice Minister Isao Matsuura met Hashimoto earlier to discuss the "Big Bang" financial reform proposals announced earlier today.
Hashimoto instructed the ministers to carry out the deregulation measures smoothly and follow developments carefully so that the overall reforms will be a success, he said.
Hashimoto also said it was necessary to consider what could be done to restore the credibility of Japanese banks and securities firms.
"I told the prime minister that we would do our utmost to realise these reforms," Mitsuzuka said.

Asked about the schedule for strengthening penalties in the banking law, Mitsuzuka said: "We would like to come up with one as quickly as we can and submit it to parliament, in cooperation with the justice minister."
